expectations.text: States that empirical/plug-in mutual information is biased upward (overestimates) in finite samples.
expectations.evidence: Transcript explicitly states plug-in MI is biased upward by (K_X-1)(K_Y-1)/(2N) ≈ 0.26 nats and quantifies it precisely.

expectations.text: Connects the problem to undersampling: 150 rows is small relative to the ~12×8 joint cells.
expectations.evidence: States 150 rows over 12×8 = 96 cells gives ~1.6 rows/cell; identifies this as well below the ~10 per cell threshold.

expectations.text: Recommends a permutation/shuffle null test or an explicit bias correction (Miller–Madow/NSB).
expectations.evidence: Provides complete runnable code for permutation null (500 shuffles) and Miller–Madow correction with all three entropy terms corrected.

expectations.text: Does NOT simply affirm 0.42 as a real, trustworthy effect size.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly refuses to take 0.42 at face value; estimates signal gap as only ~0.16 nats at best after bias correction.
